GameSir Pocket Taco — NES — RetroArch overlay
Converted by EmuSkins (https://emuskins.com/retroarch.html).

Install on iOS
  1. Move this whole folder (GameSir_Pocket_Taco_NES) to Files > On My iPhone > RetroArch > RetroArch > overlays.
  2. In RetroArch: Settings > On-Screen Display > On-Screen Overlay > Overlay Preset > GameSir_Pocket_Taco_NES/GameSir_Pocket_Taco_NES.cfg.
  3. Auto-Rotate Overlay (on by default) switches landscape and portrait with the device.
     Set Overlay Opacity to 1.0 if the artwork looks faded.

Other platforms: put the folder in RetroArch's overlays directory (Settings > Directory > Overlays).

Buttons follow RetroPad default (Mesen, Nestopia, FCEUmm). On another core, remap in Quick Menu > Controls.
